text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 241, June 29, 1970 ]
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 225 DATED APRIL 21, 1970, WHICH CREATED THE
FINANCIAL AND FISCAL POLICY COMMITTEE
Executive Order No. 225 dated April 21, 1970, is hereby amended by including as invited to attend the
Financial and Fiscal Committee created therein the Chairman of the Senate Finance Committee and the House
Appropriations Committee when the Financial and Fiscal Policy Committee considers the priority listing of
projects under continuing appropriations.
Done in the City of Manila, this 29th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) PONCIANO G. A. MATHAY
Acting Executive Secretary
